notes: «أمرني عبد الرحمن بن أبي ليلى أن أسأل ابن عباس» is an order in the story (rule 6): Ibn Abi Layla is not a link; «فسألته» makes Ibn Abbas the one asked who answers, so he is the last link.
«وعن هذه الآية ... قال نزلت في أهل الشرك» has no transmitter of its own and is not written as a route; it reads as the same speaker's continuation.
The bare «محمد» is written as the text has it; the completions in K6I and RWY are not used.
